text: Even the underlying norms of science are going to change. Some because we can live up to them better (disinterestedness) some because they may no longer apply.

Much of the world is based on the assumption that the future is like the past and an original meaning of “singularity” was a point where that relationship breaks. I don’t know if there will be one big Singularity, but a million little singularities across fields seems inevitable.

Had early access to the Intelligent UI experience and it was a nice change from walls of text. It also suggests that, increasingly, we are going to see interfaces built on demand for the problem that you have.
